title: Việt Sử People Registry
description: The single source of identity for every legendary/historical figure. Each person is defined once here; eras reference them by id (with optional per-era overrides). A figure who recurs across eras — Triệu Đà who later reigns as Triệu Vũ Đế — is ONE person here, never two.

person.description: A person's canonical identity: the default name, role, life summary and portrait art. Eras may override any of these for their own context. A figure carries EITHER a legacy `portrait` reference sheet (cropped by the app) OR dedicated `avatar` + `fullBody` images (rendered whole) — at least one image source is required.

epithet.description: Short honorific/role, e.g. "Bố Rồng" / "The Dragon Father".

bio.description: Chronicle-grounded life summary for the character detail page.

portrait.description: Legacy three-panel reference sheet (full-body left, bust top-right, action pose bottom-right), cropped by the app.

avatar.description: Dedicated square headshot, rendered whole in figure tiles. Preferred over cropping `portrait`.

fullBody.description: Dedicated standing-figure image, rendered whole on the detail page. Preferred over cropping `portrait`.
